title: Design System: Simonovski Collection
scope: this system governs the whole site at jordansimonov.ski: `/portfolio` (`portfolio/index.html`, `portfolio/portfolio.css`, `portfolio/portfolio.js`) and the home page (`/`, root `index.html` + `home.css`). `portfolio/portfolio.css` holds the shared tokens and components; `home.css` adds only the cover (plus `close--home`, a spacing tweak to the closing footer). The CV, journal and talks subdomains are separate sites and are not covered.

display.purpose: The look name only: one word, enormous, crossing the copy/plate boundary.

headline.purpose: Section titles (Activity, Archive, Index) and the closing CV / Journal / Talks links.

title.purpose: The collection title in the first look; second line italic soft ink.

statement.purpose: The activity sentence; figures italic with lining tabular numerals.

item.purpose: Archive project names; italic on hover.

label-small.purpose: Nav, archive group headings, small close links, uppercase.

data.purpose: Mono for provenance data only: edge strip, destinations, captions, calendar.

shadows.name: cell-outline
shadows.purpose: Hairline stroke on empty calendar cells. Not elevation.

shadows.name: today-ring
shadows.purpose: Marks today's calendar cell. Not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The house ease for every transition.

motion.name: colour
motion.purpose: Button ground and label colour changes.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Rail fade and tick, edge-strip current colour.

motion.name: cell
motion.purpose: Calendar cell fill when data lands.

motion.name: plate-hover
motion.purpose: Cover plate content scale to 1.05 on hover and focus.

motion.name: unveil
motion.purpose: Plate clip-path unveil upward; also the activity count-up.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Plate content scale 1.08 to 1 during the unveil.

motion.name: cover-stagger
motion.purpose: Delay between the three cover plates' CSS-only unveil, left to right.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Black rectangular primary action; persimmon on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.9rem; background: var(--ink, #12110f); color: var(--bone, #f2eee6); font: 500 0.75rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--accent, #b8431e); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b8431e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Link
components.description: Underlined secondary action beside the primary button.
components.css: .ds-quiet { padding: 0.6rem 0; color: var(--ink, #12110f); font: 500 0.75rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.6em; } .ds-quiet:hover { color: var(--accent, #b8431e); } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b8431e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Hairline masthead: anchors left, wordmark centre, outbound right; underline grows on hover.
components.html:
LooksActivityArchive
Simonovski
CVJournalGitHub
components.css: .ds-mast { height: 3.5rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 0 2rem; background: var(--bone, #f2eee6); color: var(--ink, #12110f); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--stone, #d6cfc1); } .ds-mast__group { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-mast__group--out { justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-mast__group a { position: relative; padding: 0.75rem 0; color: inherit; font: 500 0.6875rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mast__group a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0.45rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-mast__group a:hover::after, .ds-mast__group a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-mast__mark { color: inherit; font: 500 1.6rem/1 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, serif; letter-spacing: 0.32em; margin-right: -0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Edge Strip
components.description: Provenance data along the foot of a look plate; first item lights when current.
components.css: .ds-edge { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 1.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem; background: var(--ink, #12110f); color: var(--bone, #f2eee6); font: 400 0.6875rem/1.6 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-edge span:first-child { transition: color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-edge.is-current span:first-child { color: var(--accent-on-ink, #ff8f63); }

components.name: Look Rail
components.description: Fixed bone tab of look numbers; current number turns persimmon and grows a tick.
components.css: .ds-rail { margin: 0; padding: 0.9rem 0.75rem 0.9rem 1rem; list-style: none; display: inline-grid; gap: 0.9rem; background: var(--bone, #f2eee6); color: var(--ink-soft, #57524a); font: 400 0.6875rem/1 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-rail li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-rail li::after { content: ''; width: 0; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-rail li.is-current { color: var(--accent, #b8431e); } .ds-rail li.is-current::after { width: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Name Split
components.description: One look name drawn twice and clipped at the plate edge: ink over copy, plate colour over plate.
components.css: .ds-split { position: relative; height: 12rem; background: var(--bone, #f2eee6); overflow: hidden; } .ds-split__plate { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 0 38%; background: #0b0f14; } .ds-split__name { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0.5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0 1.5rem; font: 400 8rem/1.08 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, serif; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96; letter-spacing: -0.035em; white-space: nowrap; color: transparent; } .ds-split__name::before, .ds-split__name::after { content: attr(data-name); position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: inherit; } .ds-split__name::before { color: var(--ink, #12110f); clip-path: inset(0 62% 0 0); } .ds-split__name::after { color: var(--bone, #f2eee6); clip-path: inset(0 0 0 38%); }

components.name: Calendar Levels
components.description: Stone-to-ink contribution levels on square cells; today ringed in persimmon.
components.css: .ds-cal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 20px); gap: 3px; } .ds-cal i { height: 20px; background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--stone, #d6cfc1); transition: background-color 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cal i[data-l='1'] { background: #cfc7b6; box-shadow: none; } .ds-cal i[data-l='2'] { background: #9a9282; box-shadow: none; } .ds-cal i[data-l='3'] { background: #534e46; box-shadow: none; } .ds-cal i[data-l='4'] { background: var(--ink, #12110f); box-shadow: none; } .ds-cal i.is-today { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent, #b8431e); }

components.name: Archive Row
components.description: Full-row link between hairlines; name italicises and destination turns persimmon on hover.
components.html: KeknamesA Codenames clone, but shitpostier.keknames.up.railway.app
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(10rem, 3fr) minmax(0, 5fr) minmax(0, 2.5fr); gap: 0.25rem 2rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 1.25rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--stone, #d6cfc1); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--stone, #d6cfc1); color: var(--ink, #12110f); text-decoration: none; font: 400 1rem/1.6 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-row__name { font: 400 2rem/1.1 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, serif; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 48; } .ds-row__text { color: var(--ink-soft, #57524a); } .ds-row__where { justify-self: end; text-align: right; font: 400 0.6875rem/1.4 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row__name, .ds-row:focus-visible .ds-row__name { font-style: italic; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row__where { color: var(--accent, #b8431e); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b8431e); outline-offset: 3px; }

} .ds-cover__copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 2.5rem 2rem; } .ds-cover__title { margin: 0; font: 400 3.25rem/0.98 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, serif; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-cover__title span { display: block; margin-top: 0.9rem; font-size: 1.5rem; font-style: italic; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 48; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #57524a); } .ds-cover__btn { align-self: flex-start; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.9rem; background: var(--ink, #12110f); color: var(--bone, #f2eee6); font: 500 0.75rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cover__btn:hover { background: var(--accent, #b8431e); } .ds-cover__plates { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); background: var(--ink, #12110f); } .ds-plate { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; background: var(--plate); color: var(--on-plate); text-decoration: none; animation: ds-unveil 1400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) backwards; } .ds-plate + .ds-plate { border-left: 1px solid var(--bone, #f2eee6); } .ds-plate:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 120ms; } .ds-plate:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 240ms; } @keyframes ds-unveil { from { clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0); } } .ds-plate__name { padding: 0 1.25rem 1rem; font: 400 2rem/1 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, serif; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 72; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-plate__edge { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0 1rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem; background: var(--ink, #12110f); color: var(--bone, #f2eee6); font: 400 0.6875rem/1.6 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-plate__edge span:first-child { transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate__name, .ds-plate:focus-visible .ds-plate__name { font-style: italic; } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate__edge span:first-child, .ds-plate:focus-visible .ds-plate__edge span:first-child { color: var(--accent-on-ink, #ff8f63); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--on-plate); outline-offset: -4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-plate { animation: none; } }

components.name: Close Link
components.description: Headline-scale serif exit link in a hairline cell; italic persimmon on hover.
components.css: .ds-close { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #12110f); } .ds-close li { flex: 1 1 12rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--stone, #d6cfc1); } .ds-close li + li { border-left: 1px solid var(--stone, #d6cfc1); } .ds-close a { display: block; padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem 1.25rem; color: var(--ink, #12110f); font: 400 4rem/0.95 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, serif; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-close li:first-child a { padding-left: 0; } .ds-close a:hover, .ds-close a:focus-visible { font-style: italic; color: var(--accent, #b8431e); }

narrative.overview:
Side projects are presented deadpan, the way a fashion house shows a season: each piece is a full-bleed "look" with its name set monumentally in a high-contrast didone, a plate of real project imagery running to the edge, and a strip of provenance data along its foot. The joke only works if the execution is straight, so the material is quiet and expensive: a warm bone ground, near-black ink, stone hairlines, and generous matte negative space. Imagery from the projects themselves is the only texture.

Density is low and scale contrast is extreme. Monumental serif display sits against a spare, tracked-out grotesk for labels and a mono reserved for data (edge codes, code samples, the calendar). One seasonal accent, persimmon, marks whatever is current: the look in view, the hovered link, today's calendar cell.

The page rejects the developer-portfolio default: no headline over a grid of equal project cards, and no green contribution heatmap.
keyCharacteristics: Bone ground, ink type, stone hairline rules; flat and square throughout.
Didone display at monumental scale, grotesk labels in tracked uppercase, mono only for data.
Each look is a split section: a copy column and a full-bleed plate, with the project name spanning both.
One accent at a time, and it follows what is current.
One authored motion: plates unveil upward as each look arrives.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Persimmon appears only on what is current or hovered, never as decoration or a fill at rest. There is never a second accent on screen.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: A look's plate takes its project's own colours (Obsorio's night ground `#0b0f14`, PaperWing's red field `#d62f35`, Helmcov's highlighter `#faff69`), set per look. When a plate's own colour would clash with persimmon, the current-state marks borrow the project's colour in its place (PaperWing: rail `#c0262c`, edge strip `#ff8a8e`, name on plate `#fffdf5`); it replaces the accent, never sits beside it. These are look-local values, not system tokens.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda is always set at the optical size matching its use: 96 for display and headline, 72 for title, 48 for statement and item. Never use the low-contrast small-opsz cut at large sizes.

rules.name: The Italic Is The Hover Rule
rules.body: Serif links signal hover and focus by switching to italic (archive names, close links), not by underline or weight.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono only carries data: provenance codes, URLs as destinations, code samples, dates and counts. Never prose or headings.

rules.name: The Matte Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Separation is a 1px stone hairline or a change of ground, never a shadow, blur or gradient.

dos: **Do** ease every transition with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`: 300ms for colour, 400 to 600ms for rules and state, 1400 to 1800ms for the plate unveil.
**Do** give every look a plate of the project's real imagery or real output, running to the edge.
**Do** set each look's name as a single word at `display` size, crossing the copy/plate boundary.
**Do** honour reduced motion: everything visible, no unveil, no count-up, transitions cut to 1ms.
**Do** keep content visible without JS: the portfolio's motion is opt-in via the `motion` class, and the cover's CSS-only unveil animates from a fully visible resting state.
donts: **Don't** put persimmon on anything at rest, or add a second accent beside it (The One Accent Rule).
**Don't** use rounded corners, drop shadows, gradients or blur.
**Don't** set prose or headings in the mono.
**Don't** present projects as a grid of equal cards, or colour the calendar green.
